reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that monitors todo task state transitions and sends configurable native desktop reminders, including on-demand notifications.

summaries.zh: 一个监听 DeepSeek Harness 任务进度并在任务状态变化或用户请求时发送跨平台原生桌面提醒的插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that monitors task progress and sends configurable native desktop notifications when tasks change state or when requested.

capabilities: Tracks and diffs task-list snapshots per session
Displays native desktop notifications on Windows, macOS, and Linux
Provides a notify tool for on-demand reminders
Invokes platform notification commands or scripts
